name: Example: a streamer's GTA 6 gameplay
audience_rule: English captions and on-screen text, aimed at a US/UK audience.
brief:
A popular streamer is playing GTA 6 live. Goal: their best GAMEPLAY moments as short vertical clips for a GTA 6 clips page.

Clip rules:
- GAMEPLAY ONLY: something happening in GTA 6 on screen (chases, crashes, fights, fails, animals, police, missions, discoveries, glitches) with the streamer reacting to it. Skip talking to chat, IRL segments, menus, loading screens, ads and sponsor reads.
- The streamer must carry the moment with a big, funny or memorable reaction; the clip must make sense to a new viewer without context.
- Hook in the first second, payoff before the end.
- Avoid moments where licensed music plays loudly.
- Never show the streamer in a negative light; keep what they said and meant.
- Score 0 anything sexual, any nudity or slurs.

Caption rules (title, hook and descriptions):
- Accurately describe what happens; meme-style hooks are fine.
- Include #GTA6 and the streamer's hashtag.
- Clean words only; English only; title under 70 characters.
posting_checklist: Credit the streamer in the caption
Post 20-60 minutes apart; never the same clip twice on one platform
